title: The fish that survives years buried in dried mud #shorts
description: The African lungfish can survive years of drought by burrowing into mud and slowing its metabolism to a near standstill. #shorts #nature #facts #didyouknow #fish
script: Did you know a fish can survive completely out of water, buried in dried mud, for years at a time? When its swamp habitat dries up during drought, the African lungfish burrows down and secretes a mucus cocoon around its body that hardens into a protective casing, leaving only a small breathing tube open to the surface. Its metabolism slows to a near standstill, and it breathes air directly through a primitive lung instead of gills. When rains finally return, it can reawaken and swim off within hours, having essentially paused its own life for years.
